name: Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty 2
overview: The Tang Dynasty's grandeur continues, but hidden dangers lurk beneath the prosperity, and a storm is brewing. Various forces are on the move, triggering frequent mysterious incidents among the common people. What kind of supernatural mysteries will Lu Lingfeng and Su Wuming encounter on their perilous journey? The road to the west is unpredictable.
